views.label: Defended challenge
views.note: A valid response before the deadline leaves the stake untouched. The deposit reimburses the response fee per tier.

views.label: Who may challenge
views.note: The chain rejects self-challenges, unauthorized primary challenges on private buckets, expired or missing agreements and deleted leaves.

views.label: Slash
views.note: The chain rejects an invalid response. Timeout slash: a physical provider's whole stake, per_provider_stake per liable virtual member.

views.label: Cancel and extend
views.note: cancel_challenge (challenger) refunds the full deposit. extend_challenge (anyone) adds snapshotted signers to an open off-chain challenge.

cards.title: Three challenge modes
items: challenge_checkpoint: a provider in the current snapshot; for cold buckets
challenge_offchain(bucket_id, provider, agreement_id, commitment, target, provider_signatures): the chain rebuilds CommitmentPayload with its own genesis hash; for hot buckets
challenge_replica: the root the replica confirmed in last_sync
All modes: AgreementNotFound if the provider has no agreement for the bucket, AgreementExpired if it has expired (challenge_offchain: checked for agreement_id)
challenge_offchain, challenge_replica: ChallengedLeafDeleted if the leaf is below the snapshot's start_seq
extend_challenge (anyone): adds verified signatures of the agreement's snapshotted members to an open off-chain challenge; fails for a physical provider

cards.title: Who may challenge
items: Any signed account except the challenged provider (SelfChallenge)
Private bucket, primary provider: member or primary-agreement owner only (NotAuthorizedForPrivateBucket)
The gate reads the provider's role from its current agreement; replicas are open to anyone
Tier: authorized (member or any agreement owner) or public, stored in Challenge.authorized at creation

cards.title: Authorized cost split, illustrative (challenger / provider)
items: Fixed rule: challenger pays at least 50%. Public challenger: 100% / 0%

cards.title: Responses and rejections
items: Proof: chunk in leaf, leaf in committed MMR; else InvalidProof
Deleted: the snapshot's start_seq is past the challenged leaf, or the bucket was deleted; else InvalidDeletionClaim
Superseded: a newer canonical snapshot covers the leaf; not valid against challenge_replica (ChallengeKind::Replica); else InvalidSupersededClaim
Virtual provider: any member of the challenged agreement's snapshot may respond; the responder's non-reimbursed share goes to its response_cost_borne
The transaction pool drops a second response to the same challenge (or a response racing cancel_challenge) without a fee (see Transaction extension for raced calls)
A rejected response costs the provider its tx fee; the challenge stays open until the deadline
No response by the deadline: anyone calls resolve_expired_challenge (free on success); only a timeout slashes

cards.title: After a slash
items: Physical provider: loses its full stake, not a per-bucket share
Virtual provider: every signer of the challenged commitment (bundle, checkpoint set bits or last_sync_signers) loses the snapshotted per_provider_stake
The challenger gets the deposit and tx fees back, with no reward
remove_slashed (anyone, physical providers only): on a live agreement whose snapshotted stake is above locked_stake; the owner gets the remaining payment back
A slash bumps the provider's version

cards.title: Open challenges lock stake, not payment
items: Creation increments pending_challenges of the challenged provider (virtual: the synthetic account); defence, cancel or timeout decrements it once
While it is above 0 every stake lock of the provider stays active and deregister_provider fails; a challenged virtual provider locks all its members' stake
The challenge copies agreement_id, commitment, kind, snapshot and liable at creation, so settlement, burn, refund, extension and replacement activation proceed
Creation needs a live agreement, so a lock until cur_until covers every challenge not yet created
